notes.title: Thanks for Your Support + Small Update for Skewer of Heroes: Bubble Survivor!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're incredibly grateful for all your support sincethe launch of Skewer of Heroes: Bubble Survivors. Your feedback and reviews mean so much to usand help us keep improving the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we've rolled out a small update that includes:[/p][olist][*][p]Add 10 new exclusive character props[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected inconsistencies in the translation of parts such as' Recovery ',' Attack Distance ', and' Attack Angle 'in the English translation[/p][/*][*][p]Prop Adjusted: Research Book (Engineer), now changed to purple quality, attack distance+20%, number of wheel turrets+3[/p][/*][/olist][p]We're also working on more updates and newfeatures, and we'd love to hear what you'd like to see next![/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2.10D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Fix the issue of the number of props when heroes with built-in props enter or exit the team
2. Fix and restore numerical calculation errors
3. Fix the error where enemy bullet deceleration props do not work on boss bullets

PS: The official version of the game has been approved and the release date has been adjusted to June 3rd. Welcome to experience more hero mechanisms at that time!

notes.title: Version 1.2.9D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Fixed the issue where some team members, as save players, were unable to start the game normally after starting in tower climbing mode
2. Fixed the issue where the game team characters were not cleared when restarting in tower climbing mode
3. Modified the clearance time record issue for tower climbing mode
4. Fixed the issue of dropping resurrection props

PS: The official version of the game has been approved and the release date has been adjusted to June 3rd. Welcome to experience more hero mechanisms at that time!

notes.title: Version 1.2.6D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Fix bug where clearance records are not saved in tower climbing mode

2. Fix bug where there is a probability of not brushing monsters after completing one level in tower climbing mode

3. Fixed the bug where the special effect of Sword Saint caused abnormal death display after killing monsters

4. Fix the issue of incorrect display of team member numbers

5. Fix issues with phantom attack animations

PS：Due to some unexpected situations during the Steam review process for the official release version, which is currently still in the review queue, our release date may be postponed. Thank you all for your understanding.

notes.title: Version 1.2.5D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Added unique abilities for 10 heroes.

2. 7 new background tracks with randomized playback.

3. Adjusted UI to fix text overflow issues.

4. Fixed some known bugs.

5. Tweaked bond effects for certain heroes.

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Added exclusive skills for multiple Warriors

2. Introduced 10 new consumable items

3. Implemented new bubble-type variations

4. Adjusted maximum party size settings

5. Integrated random start button in Warrior selection interface

6. Rebalanced difficulty scaling and stage duration in Challenge Mode

7. Tracked personal best Challenge Mode difficulty for each Warrior

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Destructible Obstacles Added: Obstacles on the map are now breakable. Destroying them will drop temporary power-up items that grant bonuses to attack speed, movement speed, critical hit rate, and health regeneration.

2. Skill Panel Optimization: Improved visual and functional effects of the skill interface.

3. Endless Mode Balancing: Adjusted numerical difficulty scaling for a more balanced gameplay experience.

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Added cloud save functionality
2. Frozen enemies will now cease skill casting
3. Items and skills will now activate immediately upon acquisition
4. Optimized movement mechanics for S-Formation
5. Adjusted character damage coefficients
6. New loot item: Angel Wings (revives fallen teammates)
7. Added hover tooltips for formation icons + Revised core mechanics for two formations
8. Increased maximum party member limit
9. Adjusted enemy compositions across all game modes
10. Enhanced warning indicator visual effects
11. Introduced new Armor attribute
12. Streamlined stage duration in Challenge Mode
13. Refined numerical balancing system
14. Added new Armor-related items

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Added Boss progress bar in Adventure Mode

2. Increased Sigil Master's attack explosion probability

3. Enhanced visual indicators for enemy charge attacks

4. Fixed Runemaster's explosions dealing no damage

5. Patched unintended explosion triggers on missed attacks

6. Adjusted critical chance calculation for Runemaster

7. Corrected item counter display in Endless Mode

8. Resolved critical hit failure on explosions

9. Added gold reward notification for failed Challenge Mode attempts

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1. Fixed incorrect layer order of formation icons when switching languages

2. Added unique tags for items in specific game modes

3. Implemented crosshair display to better indicate mouse-aiming attack mode

4. Added hold-and-aim mechanic: Maintain left mouse button to face attack direction while adjusting aim with mouse movement

5. Fixed bug where knocked-back enemies maintained residual velocity after death

6. Resolved issue preventing boss spawns in later stages of Endless Mode

7. Corrected Blood Ring's unintended healing value amplification

8. Increased monster health scaling after 30 minutes in Endless Mode

9. Optimized various sound effects and audio processing

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1D Update Notes
notes.notes:
We've released a new update to address known issues and improve gameplay. Here are the details:

1、Fixed an incorrect hover layer order on the right-side upgrade panel.

2、Fixed a bug where the position of the special description tooltip would shift during the first hover on the character panel.

3、Fixed an issue with incorrect damage calculation for the Flamethrower Turret.

4、Added DPS (Damage Per Second) and total damage dealt stats to the character panel.

5、Introduced hover tooltips for attribute descriptions.

6、Added a treasure chest direction indicator icon at the screen edge.

7、Fixed cropping issues with character portraits.

8、Adjusted descriptions for certain items to improve clarity.

9、Added death effects for enemies that explode after clearing a level.

10、Fixed a bug where the Investigator's attack could unintentionally apply freeze and damage-over-time effects.

Thank you for your feedback, and enjoy the updated experience!
